title: Tally with reset
prompt: Write class Tally with add(n) adding n to the total, total() returning it, and clear() setting it back to zero.
hidden_tests: t = Tally(); t.add(3); t.add(4); assert t.total() == 7
t = Tally(); t.add(5); t.clear(); assert t.total() == 0
t = Tally(); t.add(2); t.clear(); t.add(1); assert t.total() == 1
teacher_lesson: clear() must zero the same attribute total() reads.

mock.label: MOCK — scripted student, not a model
